item.tib: ma mo sbod gtong gyi gter bdag ma ha de ba'i thugs sgrub snang srid dbang bsgyur gyi cha lag nyer mkho nor bu'i phreng ba
item.coloph: ces ma mo sbod gtong snang srid zil gnon gter bdag ma ha de ba'i thugs sgrub snang srid dbang bsgyur gyi cha lag nyer mkho nor bu'i phreng ba 'di ni/ gtsug phud kyis bka'i (bkas) bskul ngor/ mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal rigs dge bshes rtsa'i zhal ngo lha dbang g.yung drung mi 'gyur dge bshes rgyal po brngan hu'i pho brang bsam 'grub seng ge rdzong gi rtse mo gnam lo chu sprel gyis bzhin ras ngom pa'i hor zla dang po nyin dkar ba can du/ kho bo kun grol grags pa can gyi bstan pa la bsngags pa'i lhag bsam gyis bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig/
